title: Going from v0 to vInfinity with AI and Malte Ubl of Vercel
description:
Vercel has been a leader in offering a complete platform for the Web. With v0, this included bringing AI to the party, and this is just the beginning. Let's learn about how Vercel sees AI, what they have seen today, and where they see tomorrow!

Malte is the CTO of Vercel. Previously, Malte was a Principal Engineer responsible for Google Search Rendering and Engineering Director for Search on Laptops, Tablets, and Desktop. Additionally, Malte has created frontend infrastructure for lots of Google web apps and the web at large, and he is a founder and curator of JSConf EU.
